name: Rafael dos Anjos
summary: A former lightweight champion and one of the great pressure fighters, now 42, back from a two-year layoff and three knee surgeries (torn ACL and meniscus) and on a three-fight losing streak, cutting back to 155 where his cardio has faltered before.

how_they_fight.Defense & durability: Durable, but finished by Geoff Neal in 2024 (the fight where the knee went).
how_they_fight.Grappling: Strong top game when he gets there.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: The central question: at lightweight, the cut has drained him before.
how_they_fight.Striking: Southpaw pressure: body kicks and relentless forward movement.

concerns: Owner's notes, UFC 332: looked strong early, but 'pretty much done' by the owner's read.
keys_to_beat: Move and counter; make him chase

news.text: Returns after two years out following three knee surgeries.
